items.title: Damage Waffle Crew LS, D.Brown
items.note: A cotton waffle crew with distressing built in, so it already looks worn. Relaxed cut with dropped shoulders and a slightly longer body for layering. Made in Japan.

items.title: Chambray Baggy Chino Pants, Beige
items.note: Wide, relaxed chinos with double front pleats that round out through the hip and thigh. The fabric is a dense cotton and poly chambray with a slight sheen. The waist and hem both adjust.

items.title: Dou Trousers, Cotton Denim Sashiko, Black
items.note: Heavy cotton sashiko denim with a stone bio finish to soften it up. Relaxed fit, zip front, an inside drawstring and reinforced double knees. Made in Japan, and no big logos.

items.title: ANCELLM
items.note: A Japanese label started in 2021 by Kazuya Yamachika. Haven says the clothes use natural materials, layered dyeing and hand finishing, and are meant to change as you wear them. Most pieces cost more than £300, but the waffle crews come in well under.

items.title: 10oz Canvas Coverall, Kakishibu Wine
items.note: A chore coat in 10oz Kurashiki canvas, dyed with persimmon tannin to a wine colour that darkens in the sun. It comes pre-washed and has a hand-painted Amakusa pottery stone button. Made in Japan.

items.title: Santa Cruz Black Jeans, Relaxed Tapered
items.note: Black on black 12oz selvedge, woven on shuttle looms at Nihon Menpu. Relaxed through the top with a gentle taper below the knee. Made in Japan, with hand-felled belt loops and single needle stitching.

items.title: Double Face L/S Crewneck, Natural
items.note: A relaxed long sleeve in double faced cotton jersey. Each side has its own texture, and the two layers hold warm air. Made in Japan.

items.title: Double Face Crew Socks, Merino Wool & Organic Cotton, Charcoal
items.note: Merino on the outside and organic cotton next to the skin, in a chunky low gauge knit. Rototo knits them in Koryo, Nara, on a mix of old and new machines. An easy small treat.

items.title: Seuvas
items.note: A canvas clothing label that sews in Kurashiki, Okayama, using canvas from the nearby Takeyari mill, founded in 1888. They work with natural dyers and recycled cotton and wool, and use porcelain buttons made from Amakusa pottery stone. Rivet & Hide has new kakishibu dyed pieces in now.

items.title: 4102 Shaggy Ombre Check Open Collar Shirt, Black
items.note: An open collar shirt in a shaggy ombre check from the Osaka denim maker. It's one of a batch of new Fullcount pieces at Son of a Stag this week.

items.title: 3771 Fading Series Sweatshirt, Black
items.note: Part of Fullcount's Fading series, in plain black with no graphics. Fullcount has been making denim in Osaka since the early nineties, and its sweats are now arriving at Son of a Stag.

items.title: 5222LB Brushed Rib Flat Seam Longsleeve T Shirt, Ecru
items.note: A brushed rib long sleeve with flat seams, in ecru. A good under layer for the colder weeks, and the most affordable of the new Fullcount pieces.

items.title: Lot. 223 10oz Denim Painter Jeans, Raw
items.note: Painter jeans in raw 10oz denim. It's a loose workwear shape, and it costs less than most of the Japanese denim at Son of a Stag.

items.title: 1980s German Army Trainer, Panna Nubuck
items.note: Reproduction of Found started in 2016 and remakes military shoes, going by its own profile. This is their version of the 1980s German army trainer, in panna nubuck.

items.title: Work 5 Pocket Easy Pants, Olive
items.note: Yoko Sakamoto has new stock at both Peggs & Son and Neighbour this season. Most of the range costs well over £300, but these olive easy pants come in just under.

items.title: Stand Collar Jacket, Heather Beige
items.note: A plain stand collar jacket in heather beige from Danton. Peggs & Son has it with Danton's new half coat, hooded jacket and gloves.

items.title: Grandpa Gloves, Mix Brown
items.note: Gloves in a mixed brown from Ends and Means, new in at Peggs & Son. A small, cheap way to add something warm for winter.

items.title: Baggy Straight Pants, Dark Navy
items.note: Goldwin is a Japanese brand with its roots in skiing. These are a roomy straight leg in dark navy, new in at Oi Polloi.

items.title: Everyday Use Sacoche, Dark Brown
items.note: A small everyday shoulder bag in dark brown from Snow Peak, the outdoor company from Niigata. It's useful, low key, and £50.

items.title: 5G Boucle Cardigan, Natural
items.note: A chunky looped boucle cardigan in a melange yarn with faint tonal stripes. It's wide and boxy with a shorter body, and Goodhood says it runs large. It's mostly synthetic with a little wool.
